mutex.acting_rule: Only active owner may perform a major action; non-owner idle/glance/static/subtle life reaction only.

transitions.open: compare-and-set null -> requested owner; reject if occupied
transitions.rabbit_focused: block marmot route without toast or queue
transitions.marmot_focused: block rabbit route without toast or queue
transitions.exit: retain owner through DIALOGUE_EXITING; release only after close complete
transitions.reload: restore DIALOGUE_IDLE; do not restore half-open bubble

bubble_attachment: only active owner may bind active_owner_attachment_slot
